ms.report:
Thanks for the feedback -- we've created a visual aid for the demo video to showcase each DEX: https://vimeo.com/1054325392/81d8296ad9?share=copy
View the output of the raw data here: http://wgg8kws0kscks0woo000cw8w.167.235.164.240.sslip.io/
Description: 
We use Charli3 Dendrite to extract all raw data for every supported DEX except AXO who did not provide contract information to our team so we have to rely on their API. The front-end we created selects 5 random updates from each DEX to demo that we are gathering information every block. What you are seeing is the last slot of a block (once all slots in a block are complete, we aggregate the price from all pools/etc and show you the price). We are actively working with AXO to hopefully get details on all their contracts (these are not public).

ms.promise:
In addition the live price data updated per block completed in milestone 2, this milestone expands the processed data to include historical data. 
Enhance the database by processing data into the following categories for consumption via the API endpoint:
・Historical pool data
・Trading Volume
・5 minute period blocks of trading volume data for each token in ADA or USD
・Hourly period blocks of trading volume data for each token in ADA or USD
・Daily period blocks of trading volume data for each token in ADA or USD
・TVL
・5 minute period blocks of TVL of pools in ADA or USD
・Hourly period blocks of TVL of pools in ADA or USD
・Daily price period blocks of TVL of pools in ADA or USD
・Historical Price Data
・5 minute price of token in ADA or USD (data that can support 5 min period charts)
・Daily price of token in ADA or USD (data that can support daily charts)
・Hourly price of token in ADA or USD (data that can support hourly charts)
・Additional (optional) Data
・In addition the previously listed data points we may include others, but as a minimum the above will be delivered in this milestone
